title: Jehu
description: King of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-16 (Table 2, "The Kings of Qatna"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-16: The Kings of Israel and Judah," OSF preprint v1.3 (5 May 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/YV29C, file CFAH-16_ The Kings of Israel and Judah_v1.3.pdf, Table 2 "The Kings of Qatna", pp. 13–14
reign.note: Row "Yawa / Yama = Jehu" of Table 2 (Kings of Qatna = kings of Israel (CFAH-16)).

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 787b
reign.note: Year cell "3803 3121 128". The third printed figure 128 is the column "Temple", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 28 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..
